name: Natura & Co Holding S.A.
summary: Natura & Co Holding S.A. is a prominent entity in the beauty and personal care industry, specializing in the creation, production, and worldwide sale of cosmetics, fragrances, and hygiene products. The company offers an extensive selection, including items for body and facial care, makeup, soaps, hair treatments, deodorants, various oils, men's grooming essentials, and sun protection solutions. These products are marketed under a portfolio of renowned brands, notably Natura, Aesop, Avon, and The Body Shop. Natura & Co employs a diverse distribution strategy, reaching customers through signature retail outlets, department stores, online platforms, direct selling networks, business-to-business collaborations, and franchise operations. Its market presence spans across major global regions, including Asia, North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Oceania. Established in 1969, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in São Paulo, Brazil.
